t: Single-Wall vs. Double-Wall Tents: Which Should You Choose? – Garage Grown Gear
s: December 5, 2024 - At SlingFin, we believe that double-wall tents are usually a better choice for most people, which is why that’s primarily what we make. Single-wall tents are best as part of a multi-shelter quiver to be used when conditions are appropriate and are ideal for experienced campers with the skills to minimize condensation through proper campsite selection and deal with the condensation they will inevitably experience. If you’re buying your first tent and you want to balance functionality with weight, chances are a double-wall is the way to go.
